system.title: NIST heating interruption, 77 single-cell trials
system.citation: Tam et al., Applied Thermal Engineering 298 (2026) 131107, Tables A1/A2
system.licence: NIST open licence; US public domain
system.sensor: One surface type-K thermocouple, 1 Hz, mid-height
system.decision_point: Heater cut reconstructed with 10 s thermocouple lag; optional paid 30/60 s recorded watch

amendment_registration.reason: Frozen baselines are comparators, not candidate learning strategies

protocol.heldout_cap_unit: screened agent candidate strategies; baseline comparators do not consume K

primary_test.name: paired two-sided sign-flip permutation
primary_test.correction_family: submitted screened agent candidates times registered baseline comparators

preregistration_reasons: Observation must be available under laboratory action costs
Unsafe-only McNemar has inadequate resolution with few discordances
Video markers support a 7 s heater-off lag sensitivity alongside default 10 s
Frozen baseline comparators are not candidate learning strategies
protocol.calibration_metric: five-bin expected calibration error, with an additional Brier guard

funnel.screen: inner LOCO on revealed training only
funnel.unit: Held-out candidate submission is the agent learning strategy; frozen baselines are comparators

protocol.target: recorded ignition after recorded heater-off; no suppression counterfactual
protocol.censoring: finite observation window; censored trials flagged and sensitivity reported
